Gorilla_Heavy_Brow_Noggin.description: This massive, brow-ridged cranium is a natural fortress, its thick bone structure providing formidable armor against even the most powerful blows, while its sheer weight and size grant unparalleled strength and the devastating ability to deliver crushing headbutts that can stagger the mightiest of foes.

Chimpanzee_Domed_Skull.description: Enveloped in a thick, bony dome, the Chimpanzee_Domed_Skull component signifies an evolutionary leap in cranial fortitude and wisdom, bestowing its bearer with an enhanced constitution and a profound intellect, allowing them to execute devastating headbutt attacks that crack skulls and shatter defenses.

Mandrill_Crested_Cranium.description: Adorned with a vibrant crest of iridescent hues, the Mandrill-Crested Cranium enhances its wearer's charisma, granting them a commanding presence and a subtle wisdom, making them masters of the Intimidate skill, able to cow foes with a mere glance.

Lemur_Small_Agile_Head.description: This delicate cranial component, a marvel of primate evolution, embodies the agility and keen perception of its small lemur host, enhancing evasion and awareness while granting a proficiency in acrobatic maneuvers.

Baboon_Elongated_Snout_Cranium.description: This primordial cranium, shaped by the relentless jaws of the wild, bulges with raw strength and resilience, its elongated snout a testament to the biting prowess that has carved through flesh and bone, granting its bearer an insatiable edge in combat.

Orangutan_Flanged_Face_Cranium.description: This massive, flanged-faced cranium, a testament to the primate's dominance, bulges with a charisma that commands attention and a constitution that defies all attempts to budge it from its stance, enhancing the user’s charm and block skills.

Spider_Monkey_Nimble_Skull.description: The Spider_Monkey_Nimble_Skull is a bizarre cranial artifact derived from the cephalic anatomy of a legendary primate, imbued with an otherworldly essence that dramatically enhances agility and evasion, granting the bearer unparalleled speed and the ability to perform acrobatic feats that defy the laws of physics.

Marmoset_Tiny_Cranium.description: The Marmoset Tiny Cranium component bestows upon its bearer the sleek, agile skull of a diminutive primate, enhancing their ability to slip through shadows unseen and evade danger with preternatural grace, granting them the skill of Camouflage to blend into their surroundings effortlessly.

Spectral_Ape_Ethereal_Skull.description: The Spectral Ape Ethereal Skull, a haunting remnant of a primate once consumed by dark magic, floats with an eerie intelligence, its hollow sockets glowing with otherworldly insight, granting its bearer heightened wisdom and a subtle charisma that commands the shadows.

Zombie_Primate_Exposed_Brain_Core.description: The exposed brain core of the Zombie Primate pulses with an eerie, sickly glow, a grotesque amalgamation of decayed flesh and raw, pulsating neural tissue, granting it a formidable constitution and a chilling resilience to poisons, though its movements are sluggish and ponderous.
